mechanic.trigger: While this exact chest is equipped in hostile NPC combat, an eligible direct non-periodic hostile hit must move the wearer from above 30% to at or below 30% of maximum health. The trigger is after that hit resolves.
mechanic.effect: Consume one stored charge and place a personal absorb shield for 5 seconds; it only absorbs later eligible hostile damage.
mechanic.empty_behavior: At zero charges the chest gives no Last Stand shield or substitute passive; only a completed city recharge restores 24 charges.

bot_rules.purchase: Only consider Last Stand Aegis when a funded city supplier offers the correct wearer-level variant, compatible item slot, role use, and complete bill; compare with current legal gear and expected benefit. bot_rules.recharge: At a city station, recharge only when all charges are spent, the complete bill and fee are funded, and the order is available; keep persisted charge state through relog and item swaps.

mechanic.trigger: During pre-damage resolution of one direct, non-periodic hostile NPC spell event against the wearer, reserve one stored charge. The hit must be eligible before it resolves. Commit that charge only if the same event settles with positive damage actually absorbed; if the event cancels or no damage is absorbed, release the reservation without charge loss. Friendly, self, reflected and periodic damage never qualify.
mechanic.effect: On that same damage event, absorb 40% of its eligible damage up to the variant cap and settle the actual absorbed amount once. Only after absorb settlement, store 25% of that actual amount as an arcane echo. The next direct hostile NPC spell cast by the wearer within 8 seconds deals that echo as bonus arcane damage up to its variant cap; unused echo expires.

numbers.charge_commit_condition: positive damage actually absorbed from the same settled event

mechanic.empty_behavior: At zero charges the weapon neither absorbs nor stores/echoes energy; no mana or other resource is restored.
